  • Method Details

    • getTriggers

      public List<String> getTriggers()
      Gets the packages/versions to trigger on.

      This is syntactically equivalent to a "Requires" specification (version numbers may be used). If multiple items are given, the trigger is run when *any* of those conditions becomes true.

      Returns:
      Returns the triggers.

    • writeTrigger

      protected void writeTrigger(PrintWriter writer, AbstractRPMMojo mojo) throws IOException
      Writes the complete trigger directive. Use instead of Scriptlet.write(PrintWriter, String, AbstractRPMMojo).
      Parameters:
      writer - PrintWriter to write the trigger directive to.
      mojo - the AbstractRPMMojo which contains any resources needed when writing the trigger.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/IO error occurs
